notes: The agent catalog now covers 22 products, from Claude Code and Codex to Grok Build, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory, Kiro, MiniMax Code, Xiaomi MiMo and Agnes Code; installs, updates, uninstalls and repairs run as background tasks.
Session data reads Codex, Claude, CodeBuddy, WorkBuddy, Qoder, Kimi Code, MiMo Code and the desktop apps, with summaries, project handoffs, transfer to another computer and moving data folders.
An API service offers signed-in agent CLIs to your tools through OpenAI- and Anthropic-style endpoints, with images, PDF, streaming and an optional LAN switch.
A local encrypted key vault for API keys, tokens, SSH keys and website logins.
Disk cleanup adds a space map, duplicate files, compression of large files and whole-project removal.
The browser extension manages ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and DeepSeek web chats and syncs them into Stacker.
Updates are signed and verified before they install, and a full review fixed many safety and reliability issues.
